style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the chameleon hangs on the clothesline, whole body working every beat; bills and foam fly at him; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; he fills half the frame
character: small bright green chameleon, curled tail, swivel eyes, throat pouch, long sticky tongue; ONE plump raccoon washerwoman in apron
props: ONE slack clothesline bouncing under him, no clothes, only blank green paper bills on wooden clothespins, no digits, no text; ONE washtub with foam; ONE washboard; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunny backyard, clear blue sky behind the chameleon, washtub on the grass below the line

audio.pronunciation: mo-I sbe-re-ZHE-ni-ya me-NYA-yut TSVET ne HU-zhe me-NYA. yesh-CHO vche-RA o-NI BY-li ze-LYO-ny-mi, se-VOD-nya, o-bes-TSE-ni-lis'
audio.pacing: 0.35-7.83 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 7.83 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: paper flutter, splash, scrubbing, tongue snap, clothespin click

timeline.a: the chameleon hangs among pinned bills, half green half grey; his tail flicks a green bill off the line, it greys mid-air and flies across the lens
the chameleon swings on the line, re-gripping it with his curled tail; below, the raccoon flings up a fan of wet green bills that fly across the lens
the chameleon twists his whole body toward a pinned bill by his cheek as it fades to grey; a grey wave rolls down his flank
the chameleon rears up on the rope, throat pouch puffed, rainbow stripes racing over his skin; the raccoon wrings a bill, green water pouring out
the chameleon rocks on the rope like a leaf in wind, one foot hovering; the raccoon scrubs a bill on the washboard, foam flying near frame edge
A SWARM of green bills tears across the lens; the chameleon ducks low under them, his two eyes spinning in different directions
the chameleon stretches his neck talking, far out toward the last green bill fluttering in the foreground; it pales mid-air; the raccoon dunks a wad of bills into the washtub
the raccoon jerks the dripping wad up, foam flying across the lens; the chameleon recoils, grey flooding him tail to snout
the chameleon droops head-down on the swaying line, tail unwinding loop by loop; below, the raccoon unpins a clothespin from the rope end, snapping it open and shut
the raccoon tosses the clothespin up; the chameleon's tongue shoots out and snatches it mid-air
the chameleon's tongue whips the clothespin onto his own tail, pinning himself to the line; he lets go and dangles head-down among the grey bills like a bill
the pinned chameleon swivels one eye down and fades one shade greyer as the raccoon plucks the bill beside him into the washtub

negative_prompt: held mic, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 7.83, accented Russian, letters, numbers, clothes on the line, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, the chameleon running at the camera, far shot, static camera, night, cut, scene change
